takeaway: The IVC is formed from the common iliac veins at L5, the level where the common iliac arteries bifurcate.

lines.text: Where is the inferior vena cava formed?
The two common iliac veins join together,
and here they form the inferior vena cava.
This happens at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra, L5.
lines.say: This happens at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra, L five.

lines.text: L5 is also the site where the common iliac arteries bifurcate.
